caption: The drawing depicts a lidded goblet-shaped container with a footed base, placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The container appears to be made out of ceramic or pottery and is decorated with various colors. The lid is topped with a dark blue knob and decorated with green leaves and a green band near its edge. The body of the container has a tan base color and is adorned with a floral motif featuring a red flower with green leaves. Decorative green and red bands encircle the container near the top and bottom. The stem and base of the container are primarily red with green and blue accent bands near the foot. The artist's signature, “C. Henning,” appears in small text at the bottom left of the drawing.
title: Saffron Box
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
